## The ratio

A standard espresso shot uses a brew ratio of about 1:2, so 18 grams of ground coffee yields roughly 36 grams of liquid espresso in the cup.

## Timing

Most shots run between 25 and 30 seconds from the moment the pump starts. A shot that finishes in under 20 seconds is usually under-extracted and tastes sour. A shot that runs past 35 seconds is usually over-extracted and tastes bitter.

## Fixing a sour shot

The first adjustment for a sour, fast shot is to grind finer, which slows the water down and extracts more.
